created_for: Pipeline verification and fresh replication runs only
disclaimer: Entirely fictional research data. No real patient, provider, payer, member, identifier, code assignment, or coverage determination is represented. Not medical advice and not for clinical decision support.

generation.replicates: Microsoft Prior-Authorization Multi-Agent Solution Accelerator roles
generation.phi_review: No source patient records or protected health information were used
generation.case_expansion: Each topic expands to four graded sensitivity levels x canary-absent/present; the canary replaces the sixth (distractor) document so every case has six documents
generation.sensitivity_ladder: L0..L3 grade the step-therapy documentation (complete, minor gap, material gap, absent), the diagnostic findings (confirmatory, suggestive, equivocal, pending), the service requested, and the fixture target hop depth
generation.length_matching: Character counts are matched across the four levels of every topic: each document role within 6% and each case total within 3% of its mean, enforced at build time by _assert_length_band. Unmatched text volume would be a monotone confound perfectly correlated with the ladder
generation.canary_vocabulary: The canary names no service. v1 named the top-of-ladder service in every canary, entangling the membership and attribute labels; it now carries only a distinctive prior-therapy timeline and a named comorbidity
